title: Hagati y'Isi n'Ijuru
intro: Roho y'amayobera iragutegereje mu mapaji matagatifu y'amateka y'Imana, ifite ibimenyetso n'ibitangaza bikigaragara mu bihe bitandukanye. Uko ukurikira inzira y'ibimenyetso, uzanyura mu nkuru igaragaza ibitangaza - kuva ku ntangiriro y'igitangaza kugeza ku kuzamuka hejuru y'ijuru. Ese ushobora kumenya uyu mugaragu w'umugisha mbere y'uko ubona ikimenyetso cya nyuma?
clues: Natumwe nk'intumwa ku Bana ba Isirayeli mbazanira inkuru z'imbabazi n'urumuri.
Ivuka ryanjye ryari ikimenyetso cy'igitangaza — naje muri iyi si nta se, ku itegeko ry'Ishoborabyose.
Navugaga nkiri uruhinja, nburanira icyubahiro cya mama ku birego by’abaturage be.
Ku bw'uburenganzira bwa Allah, naremye inyoni mu ibumba ndazihumekeramo ubuzima — zaragurutse zigenda imbere y'abazirebaga.
Nakijije abavutse ari impumyi, nkiza ababembe, ndetse nanazuye abapfuye — nyamara igitangaza cyose cyakozwe ku bushake bwa Allah, ntabwo ari njye ubwanjye.
Ubwo abanzi banjye bashakaga kunrimbura, Allah yanzamuye mu ijuru maze asezeranya kugaruka kwanjye mbere y'umunsi w'urubanza.

outcome.label: Icyambayeho
options: Nasubiye kubonana n'umuryango wanjye nyuma y'igihe kirekire dutandukanye

arabic: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا عَبْدٌ أَنْعَمْنَا عَلَيْهِ وَجَعَلْنَـٰهُ مَثَلًۭا لِّبَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ
verse: He [i.e., Jesus] was not but a servant upon whom We bestowed favor, and We made him an example for the Children of Israel. (43:59)
